description: Geotechnical Demands for Characterizing Performance of Pipeline Systems with Enlarged Components is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Hailey-Rae Rose, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). The project included a series of centrifuge experiments performed at CU Boulder's Center for Infrastructure, Energy, and Space Testing. The 15 g-ton centrifuge was used to test n=12.5 reduced scale pipelines with enlarged joints that act as anchors in the ground. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: pipeline, infrastructure resilience, hazard resilient pipelines. Published 2023-10-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
